name: nextbot-widget-embed
description: Vite library build target — loader script + iframe-hosted widget app for the embeddable widget (BL-04). Two independent build outputs: the vanilla-JS `nextbot.js` loader (host-page <script> tag) and the React+Tailwind/shadcn widget SPA that runs inside the loader's iframe, each with its own scoped theme/CSS build (`docs/plans/chakra-to-shadcn-plan.md` Plan Phase 5, superseding ADR-0002 §4.2a's Chakra-based description — see ADR-0010) — neither depends on apps/web's Next.js build or its own CSS/token instance.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:widget && pnpm run build:loader
